title: Daily Life - At The Train Station

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and we're on the road today.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，我们今天在路上。

segments.en: We're traveling a little bit.
segments.zh: 我们有点旅行。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we have a lesson that was requested by one of our users and I think it's a very handy lesson.
segments.zh: 今天我们有一个我们的用户要求的课程，我认为这是一个非常方便的课程。

segments.en: If we're traveling, we are buying tickets at a train station.
segments.zh: 如果我们旅行，我们将在火车站购买车票。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I personally love traveling by train.
segments.zh: 所以我个人喜欢乘火车旅行。

segments.en: I think it's a very romantic way to see different countries, different places.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一种非常浪漫的方式，可以看到不同的国家，不同的地方。

segments.en: We're going to learn all about how to get tickets and how to talk about different parts of a train.
segments.zh: 我们将学习如何获得门票以及如何谈论火车的不同部分。

segments.en: So let's first listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们先听我们的对话。

segments.en: Hi, I would like to purchase a one-way ticket to Brussels, please.
segments.zh: 你好，我想买一张去布鲁塞尔的单程票。

segments.en: Certainly, sir.
segments.zh: 好的，先生。

segments.en: This is our train schedule.
segments.zh: 这是我们的火车时刻表。

segments.en: We have an express train departing every morning and an overnight train that departs at 9 p.m.
segments.zh: 我们每天早上都有一列特快列车，晚上 9 点出发的过夜火车。

segments.en: How long does it take to get there?
segments.zh: 到达那里需要多长时间?

segments.en: About 12 hours.
segments.zh: 大约12个小时。

segments.en: We currently have tickets available only for first class on the express train.
segments.zh: 目前特快列车只剩下一等座车票。

segments.en: If you'd like, you can choose a sleeper on the overnight train, which is a bit less expensive.
segments.zh: 如果您愿意，您可以在过夜火车上选择卧铺，这有点便宜。

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's the best option.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是最好的选择。

segments.en: Do you serve food on a train?
segments.zh: 您在火车上提供食物吗?

segments.en: 12 hours is such a long time.
segments.zh: 12小时是这么长的时间。

segments.en: Yes, of course.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。

segments.en: There is a dining car towards the end of the train where they serve meals at all times.
segments.zh: 火车尽头有一辆餐车，他们随时提供餐点。

segments.en: We do provide complimentary water and coffee for all of our passengers.
segments.zh: 我们为所有乘客提供免费的水和咖啡。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: I'll take it.
segments.zh: 我要这个。

segments.en: Here you are, sir.
segments.zh: 给您，先生。

segments.en: Your train leaves from platform number 9 at 9 on the dot.
segments.zh: 您的火车九点整从九号站台发车。

segments.en: Remember to be here at least 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time or else you might miss your train.
segments.zh: 请记住至少在您预定的出发时间前 30 分钟到达这里，否则您可能会错过火车。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Thank you very much.
segments.zh: 非常感谢。

segments.en: Have a great trip.
segments.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now we're going to take a look at a couple of words that we've picked out for you on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们来看看我们在外卖时为你挑选的几个词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So there are many different kinds of tickets you can purchase, you can buy for your train journey.
segments.zh: 所以你可以购买许多不同种类的车票，你可以为你的火车旅行购买。

segments.en: The first time we're going to talk about is maybe the fastest.
segments.zh: 我们第一次谈论可能是最快的。

segments.en: This is called an express train.
segments.zh: 这被称为特快列车。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as the name says, it's an express train.
segments.zh: 顾名思义，它是一列特快列车。

segments.en: That means it's a very fast train.
segments.zh: 这意味着它是一辆非常快的火车。

segments.en: And it depends because in different places, sometimes they call it the fast train, sometimes they call it the express train.
segments.zh: 这取决于在不同的地方，有时他们称之为快车，有时他们称之为快车。

segments.en: But basically the idea is that it's a very fast train.
segments.zh: 但基本上这个想法是它是一辆非常快的火车。

segments.en: And it's fast usually because it stops very few times.
segments.zh: 它通常很快，因为它停止的次数很少。

segments.en: For example, if we want to go on the Paris to Berlin train, it won't stop in every single town.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我们想乘坐巴黎到柏林的火车，它不会停在每个城镇。

segments.en: It will probably only stop a couple of times.
segments.zh: 它可能只会停止几次。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So apart from the express trains that usually they'll go in the daytime, we have an overnight train.
segments.zh: 所以除了通常他们会在白天去的快车外，我们还有一辆通宵火车。

segments.en: Overnight trains are very fun, or at least they can be fun if you have a comfortable place to sleep.
segments.zh: 过夜火车非常有趣，或者至少如果您有一个舒适的睡眠场所，它们会很有趣。

segments.en: Basically the idea is you get on the train at night and you sleep on the train and you get off in the morning.
segments.zh: 基本上这个想法是你晚上上火车，睡在火车上，早上下车。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's actually a very popular way of traveling, especially if you're on a budget because you're basically saving yourself one night of spending the night at a hotel.
segments.zh: 这实际上是一种非常受欢迎的旅行方式，特别是如果您的预算有限，因为您基本上可以节省一晚在酒店过夜的乐趣。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you're going to have to find a place to sleep if you're taking the overnight train.
segments.zh: 所以如果你乘坐过夜火车，你将不得不找个地方睡觉。

segments.en: There are usually different options.
segments.zh: 通常有不同的选择。

segments.en: The most uncomfortable is usually a seat, like a hard seat.
segments.zh: 最不舒服的通常是一个座位，就像一个硬座。

segments.en: But there are oftentimes special cars on a train where you can sleep for these overnight trips.
segments.zh: 但是火车上经常有特殊的汽车，您可以在那里过夜旅行。

segments.en: What are those called?
segments.zh: 那些叫什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And those are called sleeper cars or you choose a sleeper seat.
segments.zh: 那些被称为卧铺车，或者你选择卧铺座椅。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that's pretty easy to remember.
segments.zh: 所以这很容易记住。

segments.en: So you choose a sleep sleeper.
segments.zh: 所以你选择睡眠睡眠者。

segments.en: The sleeper seats are the seats that fold back like you're lying down.
segments.zh: 卧铺座椅是像躺着一样向后折叠的座椅。

segments.en: But of course most places like China and India and Vietnam for example have actual cars that have beds in them.
segments.zh: 但当然，例如中国、印度和越南等大多数地方都有真正的汽车，里面有床。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you can, as the name says, you can actually sleep on this train.
segments.zh: 所以你可以，顾名思义，你实际上可以睡在这辆火车上。

segments.en: Now if you're going to buy tickets, you're not going to find a sleeper train on an express train or a train that travels during the day.
segments.zh: 现在，如果您要购买车票，您将不会在特快列车或白天行驶的火车上找到卧铺列车。

segments.en: These are only available at night usually.
segments.zh: 这些通常只在晚上可用。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So a sleeper car is what you want to look for if you're traveling overnight.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您在一夜之间旅行，卧铺车就是您想要寻找的东西。

segments.en: And in those cases, you oftentimes get hungry.
segments.zh: 在这些情况下，你经常会饿。

segments.en: You need to eat.
segments.zh: 你需要吃饭。

segments.en: So where do you go to eat?
segments.zh: 那么你去哪里吃饭呢？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're going to look for the dining car on the train.
segments.zh: 我们要在火车上寻找餐车。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So think about the word dining room.
segments.zh: 所以想想餐厅这个词。

segments.en: Dining room, dining car, this means the place where you eat.
segments.zh: 餐厅，餐车，这意味着您吃饭的地方。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we're going to look for a dining car and it's usually in the front of the train I think and you can just go and get a quick meal over there.
segments.zh: 所以我们要找一辆餐车，我想它通常在火车的前面，你可以去那里吃一顿快餐。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Dining car.
segments.zh: 餐车。

segments.en: And finally, we have another very important word here.
segments.zh: 最后，我们在这里有另一个非常重要的词。

segments.en: It's all about getting on and off the train.
segments.zh: 这一切都是为了上下火车。

segments.en: So where do you do that?
segments.zh: 那么你在哪里做呢？

segments.en: Well, you go to the platform, the specific platform where your train is leaving.
segments.zh: 好吧，你去站台，你的火车离开的特定平台。

segments.en: So in this case, this guy has to go to platform number nine.
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，这家伙必须去九号站台。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So usually that means that there is a cement or a stone block where you stand.
segments.zh: 所以通常这意味着你站的地方有水泥或石块。

segments.en: The train comes to the station.
segments.zh: 火车来到车站。

segments.en: People get off, you get on.
segments.zh: 人们下车，你上车。

segments.en: So the place where that all happens is the platform.
segments.zh: 所以这一切发生的地方是平台。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And remember that in airplanes or in airports, usually you look for a terminal.
segments.zh: 请记住，在飞机或机场，您通常会寻找航站楼。

segments.en: For train stations, you're looking for a platform.
segments.zh: 对于火车站，您正在寻找一个平台。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And that number is going to be very important.
segments.zh: 这个数字将非常重要。

segments.en: So look at your ticket and find out which platform your train will be arriving or departing from.
segments.zh: 因此，查看您的车票，找出您的火车将到达或离开的平台。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: The first one is a kind of ticket you can buy.
segments.zh: 第一个是你可以买的票。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We're looking for a one-way ticket to Brussels.
segments.zh: 我们正在寻找一张前往布鲁塞尔的单程票。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a one-way ticket means you go to Brussels but you don't come home.
segments.zh: 所以单程票意味着你去布鲁塞尔，但你不回家。

segments.en: Maybe you have a flight later or you have a car waiting for you.
segments.zh: 也许你以后有航班，或者你有一辆车等着你。

segments.en: You don't need a return ticket on that train.
segments.zh: 你不需要在那列火车上买回程票。

segments.en: One-way ticket is the opposite of a round-trip ticket.
segments.zh: 单程票与往返机票相反。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So usually, for example, if you live in New York and you're going on vacation, you're going to buy a round-trip ticket because you need to go back to your city.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果您住在纽约并且要去度假，您将购买一张往返机票，因为您需要返回您的城市。

segments.en: But in this case, we're getting a one-way ticket.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，我们将获得单程票。

segments.en: So we're just buying a ticket that will only take us there.
segments.zh: 所以我们只是买一张只会带我们去那里的票。

segments.en: It's not going to bring us back.
segments.zh: 它不会把我们带回来。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: One-way ticket.
segments.zh: 单程票。

segments.zh: 在那之后，我们有一个很好的问题。

segments.en: This is something we can ask in many, many different situations.
segments.zh: 这是我们可以在许多不同的情况下提出的问题。

segments.en: Here the person buying the ticket wants to know how long does it take to get there.
segments.zh: 在这里，买票的人想知道到达那里需要多长时间。

segments.en: He's talking about Brussels.

segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: So let's take a look at this structure.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看这个结构。

segments.en: We can say how long does it take to and then we can add another verb there.
segments.zh: 我们可以说需要多长时间，然后我们可以在那里添加另一个动词。

segments.en: So for example, we want to know the amount of time it is going to require.
segments.zh: 例如，我们想知道它需要多少时间。

segments.en: For example, here we are asking how long does it take to get there, in this case to Brussels.
segments.zh: 例如，在这里我们询问到达那里需要多长时间，在这种情况下到布鲁塞尔。

segments.en: We're asking how much time is needed to go to Brussels, but what if we change the last part?
segments.zh: 我们在问去布鲁塞尔需要多少时间，但如果我们改变了最后一部分呢？

segments.en: Well, there's anything.
segments.zh: 嗯，有什么事。

segments.en: We could say anything here.
segments.zh: 我们可以在这里说什么。

segments.en: We could say how long does it take to bake a pizza?
segments.zh: 我们可以说烤比萨需要多长时间？

segments.en: Or for example, Marco, how long does it take for you to do your hair in the morning?
segments.zh: 或者，例如，Marco，你早上做头发需要多长时间？

segments.en: Like 20 seconds.
segments.zh: 比如20秒。

segments.en: Not very long.
segments.zh: 不是很长。

segments.en: Not very long.
segments.zh: 不是很长。

segments.en: You could even change the name of the place you're going to.
segments.zh: 您甚至可以更改您要去的地方的名称。

segments.en: So how long does it take to get to Beijing?
segments.zh: 那么到北京需要多长时间呢？

segments.en: Exactly, so just remember this structure when you want to ask the amount of time needed.
segments.zh: 确切地说，当您想询问所需的时间量时，请记住此结构。

segments.en: Of course, there are other ways and sometimes it's very common to make a little bit of mistakes saying how much time to Beijing or something like this.
segments.zh: 当然，还有其他方法，有时会犯一些错误，说出去北京的时间或类似的事情。

segments.en: Or how many hours.
segments.zh: 或多少小时。

segments.en: We don't really say that in English.
segments.zh: 我们真的不是用英语说的。

segments.en: We say how much time.
segments.zh: 我们说多少时间。

segments.en: So how much time does it take?
segments.zh: 那么需要多少时间呢？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And what about when the person that's selling the ticket said, okay, the train leaves from platform number nine at nine on the dot?
segments.zh: 那么当卖票的人说，好吧，火车从九号站台九号站出发时呢？

segments.en: Okay, so I'm not really sure where this idea of a dot comes from, but I think it has to do with clocks.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我不确定这个点的想法来自哪里，但我认为它与时钟有关。

segments.en: So basically when you look at a clock and all of a sudden the hand comes to 12, so it's nine o'clock, the hand is on the 12, that is on the dot.
segments.zh: 所以基本上当你看一个时钟，突然的手到了12，所以是九点钟，手在12上，就是在点上。

segments.en: That means exactly.
segments.zh: 这意味着确切地说。

segments.en: Okay, so the train is leaving at nine zero zero, not nine 30, not nine 15.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以火车在九个零时离开，而不是九个 30，而不是九个 15。

segments.en: It's leaving exactly at nine o'clock.
segments.zh: 它正好在九点钟离开。

segments.en: So we can also say this in normal speech when we're talking to our friends.
segments.zh: 因此，当我们与朋友交谈时，我们也可以在正常的演讲中说这一点。

segments.en: I could say, Marco, we're going to leave at six on the dot.
segments.zh: 我可以说，马可，我们将在六点钟离开。

segments.en: Any later and we'll miss the movie.
segments.zh: 以后，我们会错过这部电影。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: But when you say on the dot, you're usually emphasizing that it leaves promptly.
segments.zh: 但是当你在点上说时，你通常会强调它会及时离开。

segments.en: It's not going to be late and you're kind of emphasizing a person to be on time.
segments.zh: 不会迟到，你有点强调一个人准时。

segments.en: Yes, please don't be late because, so nine oh one or in my case, six oh four, these are not okay because they're too late.
segments.zh: 是的，请不要迟到，因为九哦一，或者在我的情况下，六点四，这些都不行，因为它们太晚了。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So I'm going to pick you up at four o'clock on the dot.
segments.zh: 所以我要在四点钟接你。

segments.en: Usually means I don't really want to wait, so please be ready at four.
segments.zh: 通常意味着我真的不想等待，所以请在四点准备好。

segments.en: All right, so on the dot.
segments.zh: 好吧，等等。

segments.en: All right, so now let's listen to our dialogue for the last time and we'll be back to talk with you a little bit more.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们最后一次听我们的对话，我们会回来和你多谈谈。

segments.en: Hi, I would like to purchase a one-way ticket to Brussels, please.
segments.zh: 你好，我想买一张去布鲁塞尔的单程票。

segments.en: Certainly, sir.
segments.zh: 好的，先生。

segments.en: This is our train schedule.
segments.zh: 这是我们的火车时刻表。

segments.en: We have an express train departing every morning and an overnight train that departs at nine PM.
segments.zh: 我们每天早上都有一列特快列车，晚上九点出发的过夜火车。

segments.en: How long does it take to get there?
segments.zh: 到达那里需要多长时间?

segments.en: About 12 hours.
segments.zh: 大约12个小时。

segments.en: We currently have tickets available only for first class on the express train.
segments.zh: 目前特快列车只剩下一等座车票。

segments.en: If you'd like, you can choose a sleeper on the overnight train, which is a bit less expensive.
segments.zh: 如果您愿意，您可以在过夜火车上选择卧铺，这有点便宜。

segments.en: Yeah, I think that's the best option.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这是最好的选择。

segments.en: Do you serve food on a train?
segments.zh: 您在火车上提供食物吗?

segments.en: 12 hours is such a long time.
segments.zh: 12小时是这么长的时间。

segments.en: Yes, of course.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。

segments.en: There is a dining car towards the end of the train where they serve meals at all times.
segments.zh: 火车尽头有一辆餐车，他们随时提供餐点。

segments.en: We do provide complimentary water and coffee for all of our passengers.
segments.zh: 我们为所有乘客提供免费的水和咖啡。

segments.en: Great, I'll take it.
segments.zh: 太好了，我会接受的。

segments.en: Here you are, sir.
segments.zh: 给您，先生。

segments.en: Your train leaves from platform number nine at nine on the dot.
segments.zh: 你的火车从九号站台的九号站出发。

segments.en: Remember to be here at least 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time or else you might miss your train.
segments.zh: 请记住至少在您预定的出发时间前 30 分钟到达这里，否则您可能会错过火车。

segments.en: I understand.
segments.zh: 我明白了。

segments.en: Thank you very much.
segments.zh: 非常感谢。

segments.en: Have a great trip.
segments.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

segments.en: All right, so you mentioned you really like to travel on trains.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以你提到你真的很喜欢坐火车旅行。

segments.en: I do.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Why is that?
segments.zh: 为什么会这样？

segments.en: Well, I like that trains are kind of slow.
segments.zh: 嗯，我喜欢火车有点慢。

segments.en: Many trains are slow.
segments.zh: 许多火车都很慢。

segments.en: Some trains, as we said, like express trains are faster.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，有些火车比特快列车更快。

segments.en: But if you're traveling in a new place, it's a wonderful way to see the country because maybe you're going from one city to another city.
segments.zh: 但如果你在一个新的地方旅行，这是一个很好的方式去看这个国家，因为也许你要从一个城市到另一个城市。

segments.en: Well, it's nice to see what's in between cities.
segments.zh: 好吧，很高兴看到城市之间的情况。

segments.en: So that's why I like to be on trains.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我喜欢上火车的原因。

segments.en: I actually also really enjoy taking the overnight trains because I sometimes get a little bit uncomfortable if I travel for too long, for example, on an airplane or a car.
segments.zh: 实际上，我也很喜欢乘坐过夜火车，因为如果我旅行太久，例如在飞机或汽车上，我有时会有点不舒服。

segments.en: So if I fall asleep and I wake up where I wanted to go, it's really nice.
segments.zh: 所以如果我睡着了，我醒来了我想去的地方，那真是太好了。

segments.en: Well, and I think it's nice also to be kind of rolled asleep, you know, lulled asleep by the train.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为在火车上睡着了也很好，你知道，睡着了。

segments.en: Have you had any like very memorable train experiences?
segments.zh: 你有过非常难忘的火车经历吗？

segments.en: Traveling around, I have met some interesting people and actually they, you know, local people.
segments.zh: 到处旅行，我遇到了一些有趣的人，实际上他们，你知道的，当地人。

segments.en: So they start talking to you and really curious because obviously you're a foreigner in their country and try to get to know you and maybe even give you a little bit of advice.
segments.zh: 所以他们开始和你说话并且真的很好奇，因为显然你是他们国家的外国人，并试图了解你，甚至可能会给你一些建议。

segments.en: And if you don't speak the language, it's even a little bit more interesting because you're trying to communicate and you pick up a lot of words.
segments.zh: 如果你不会说这种语言，它会更有趣，因为你正在尝试交流并且你会听到很多单词。

segments.en: That's true.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: I actually heard some really interesting stories from people who took the Trans-Siberian Railway from Beijing to Moscow.
segments.zh: 我实际上从北京到莫斯科乘坐跨西伯利亚铁路的人听到了一些非常有趣的故事。

segments.en: They said the more vodka you drink, the more foreign languages you speak.
segments.zh: 他们说你喝的伏特加越多，你说的外语就越多。

segments.en: So I don't know if any of our users have done that.
segments.zh: 所以我不知道我们的任何用户是否都这样做了。

segments.en: You guys should let us know if you have any fun train travel experiences.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何有趣的火车旅行体验，你们应该告诉我们。

segments.en: I know Marco certainly has some.
segments.zh: 我知道马可当然有一些。

segments.en: I've got some of my own.
segments.zh: 我有一些我自己的。

segments.en: So we'll all have to share on our website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以我们都必须在我们的网站 englishpod.com 上分享。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And if you have any other questions, we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 如果您有任何其他问题，我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye-bye for now.
segments.zh: 现在再见。
